controllers-python.title: Controllers on Python
controllers-python.query: timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend == "hidapi"} | fieldsAdd count = arrayLast(avg(controller_backend_info)) | summarize total = countIf(count > 0)

controllers-rust.title: Controllers on Rust
controllers-rust.query: timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend == "rust"} | fieldsAdd count = arrayLast(avg(controller_backend_info)) | summarize total = countIf(count > 0)

canary-rollout.title: Canary Rollout %
canary-rollout.description: Percentage of controllers on Rust backend
canary-rollout.query: timeseries rust = avg(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend == "rust"}, by:{serial} | summarize rustCount = count() | lookup [timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), filter:{backend != "mock"}, by:{serial} | summarize totalCount = count()], sourceField:, lookupField: | fieldsAdd pct = rustCount / totalCount * 100 | fields pct

pipeline-cpu.title: Pipeline CPU (Stacked)
pipeline-cpu.description: Combined CPU cost of controller-manager + rust-hid. Shows true total pipeline cost regardless of which backend is active.
pipeline-cpu.query: timeseries avg(process_cpu_seconds_total, rate: 5m), by:{service.name}, filter:{service.name IN ("controller-manager-service", "rust-hid")}

pipeline-memory.title: Pipeline Memory (Stacked)
pipeline-memory.description: Combined resident memory of controller-manager + rust-hid. Shows true total footprint of both processes.

input-lag.title: Input Lag by Backend
input-lag.description: p95 input lag split by backend type
input-lag.query: timeseries percentile(controller_input_lag_seconds, 95), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize p95 = avg(arrayLast(`percentile(controller_input_lag_seconds, 95)`)), by:{backend}

update-frequency.title: Update Frequency by Backend
update-frequency.description: Controller update rate (Hz) split by backend
update-frequency.query: timeseries avg(controller_state_update_hz), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize avgHz = avg(arrayLast(`avg(controller_state_update_hz)`)), by:{backend}

poll-drops.title: Poll Drops by Backend
poll-drops.description: Poll drop rate split by backend type
poll-drops.query: timeseries sum(controller_poll_drops_total, rate: 1m), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize drops = sum(arrayLast(`sum(controller_poll_drops_total)`)), by:{backend}

disconnects.title: Disconnects by Backend
disconnects.description: Controller disconnect rate split by backend type
disconnects.query: timeseries sum(controller_disconnect_total, rate: 1m), by:{serial} | lookup [timeseries avg(controller_backend_info), by:{serial, backend}], sourceField:serial, lookupField:serial | fieldsAdd backend | summarize disconnects = sum(arrayLast(`sum(controller_disconnect_total)`)), by:{backend}

pipeline-threads.title: Pipeline Threads
pipeline-threads.description: Thread count for controller-manager and rust-hid
